questions.source_question_prompt_en: What is the main question of the study?

choices.excerpt_en: The transport office asked about weekend revenue, but our assignment is narrower. We must assess whether students can get home safely after evening classes, particularly those finishing in the science buildings at nine.
The first spreadsheet made the pilot look popular. Then I noticed the totals included passengers on the regular airport route, which shares a stop but is not part of the night-bus scheme at all.

Asking people before boarding would measure expectations rather than actual journeys. Interviewing them immediately after they get off gives us a more accurate account of waiting, transfers and how safe they felt.

questions.feedback_vi: Câu hỏi này được chứng minh tại lượt T03. Hai lựa chọn còn lại là lời nói có thật nhưng nằm ở các ý khác trong cùng đoạn nghe.
